turns.learner: Hello! I need English for daily life here. Can we practise the present continuous (am/is/are + -ing)?
turns.tutor:
Yes, the present continuous is useful for saying what is happening now. We use am, is or are plus a verb with -ing.

Here is one solved example. "Anna ___ (read) now." Anna is one person, so I choose "is". The verb is read, so I add -ing. Full sentence: Anna is reading now.

Now you finish this one. I did the first step: two people, so "are".
"The men are ___ (cook) dinner now."
Write the full sentence.
